From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Discovery recap + next step: technical deep dive / PoC prep

Hi Erin — thanks again for a constructive call earlier today. Quick recap and a proposal for next steps so we can lock the technical deep dive and PoC kickoff: 

Recap (30m call)
- Primary goal: evaluate Redwood inference for low-latency model serving for internal genomics QA workflows.
- Key constraints: HIPAA-adjacent data handling, VPC/private deployment possible, target 150ms p95 on 8k token windows for batch scoring.
- Stakeholders you mentioned: Naveen (platform lead), Samantha (security), ML team for accuracy thresholds.

Suggested next step — Technical deep dive (60 minutes)
- Purpose: map PoC success criteria, share infra requirements (network, keys), walk sample requests and latency profile, discuss data residency / audit logging.
- Agenda (proposed): 1) brief PoC scope & success criteria (10m), 2) infra & security Qs (15m), 3) demo of serving runtime and KV cache behavior (20m), 4) open Q&A + next steps (15m).

Proposed times (ET) — please pick one and confirm attendees: 
- Tue Aug 31, 11:00–12:00 ET
- Wed Sep 1, 14:00–15:00 ET
- Thu Sep 2, 09:30–10:30 ET

Also: which conferencing tool do you prefer (Google Meet / Zoom)? Should we include a separate calendar invite with an ICS you can import?

Attachments: discovery-notes.pdf (high-level notes from today's call). I can also drop a one-page mutual action plan (MAP) if you'd like to accelerate approvals.

If you want us to preview a short checklist for the PoC infra, Ben (cc'd) can share a template ahead of the meeting.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
grace@redwoodinference.com
Phone: 415-555-0182
